firstPlayerRule: Randomly choose the First Player and give them the First Player marker.
clarifications: The First Player chooses first in the opening card draft, which proceeds clockwise; the second draft goes in reverse order.
Production and action turns begin with the First Player and proceed clockwise. Pass the marker clockwise during cleanup.
